description: Maps a story-script character id to its selectable costume/portrait rows in ScriptCharacterClothesDataTable.

ID.technical: FName row key used as the lookup argument in UGameStoryDemoImage's clothes helper (ScriptCharacterDataTables, retail DTM +0xA60). Exported ids are character codes such as CP_010 / CN_122.

Id_ScriptCharacterClothes.simple: Costume rows available for this character.
Id_ScriptCharacterClothes.technical: TArray<FName>; indexed by the sequencer section's ClothesIndex. IsValidIndex guards the access; a None entry still reaches the clothes-row lookup, which returns null for that slot. Exported rows have four fixed slots.

notes: Row constructor is empty; no default costume ids are injected in C++ (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_ScriptCharacter.cpp:3).
The only identified consumer is the story-demo portrait path; no direct Blueprint calls are claimed (Blueprints are not a source of behaviour in this project), and the available Content is partial.
Single exported table, no numbered shards or localization variants.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Resolves CharacterId in DTM +0xA60, then uses the indexed costume id for DTM +0xA70.
